senses.gloss: m. (preced.) inner, inside (adj. a. adv.) Targ. I Kings VI, 27; a. e.—
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 8:1:5">Y. Sabb. VIII, 11ᵃ</cite> top <he>בהין גיויא</he> of the inside (reed), opp. <cite ref="B01160"><he>בראה</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>גַּוָּואִין</he>, <he>גַּוָּואֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 6:4">Targ. Y. Num. VI, 4</cite>.—
<cite ref="Chullin 47a">Ḥull. 47ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>מג׳</he> from the inner lungs (lower part), opp. <cite ref="A00236"><he>אַגַּבָּא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 29b:9">B. Bath. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>שכוני ג׳</he> the interior compartments.
<cite ref="Chagigah 5b:11">Ḥag. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>בתי ג׳</he> the inner chambers of the heavens; a. fr.—Fem. <he>גַּוַּיְתָא</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 40:27">Targ. Ezek. XL, 27</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="C00359"><he>גַּוְיָאתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Eruvin 25b:8">Erub. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>גודא ג׳</he> (read <he>גודי</he>, Ms. M. <he>גודי גואי</he>) inner partitions.
